hooks.text: 为最后一班冰岛渡轮筹够燃料，横穿尸群占领的拉脱维亚逃生
hooks.excerpt: The military is announcing that one last ferry will be heading out to Iceland from the western shore. Escape will be granted to those with enough fuel for the entry fee, and enough courage to attempt the journey across zombie-infested Latvia.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 按独特能力与性格组建幸存者队伍，并用饰品和成长定制战术
hooks.excerpt: The combat is heavily strategic, allowing customisation in team composition and character progression, and the game features dozens of trinkets that provide passive bonuses following the best roguelike design practices. Between combats, you must make decisions about traversing the landscape, and written events force you to navigate the moral complexities of surviving in a hostile environment. Features Form a team of survivors, each with unique abilities and personalities. Decide the fates of your team members as you go
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 在搜刮事件中处理生存道德困境，八万字剧情持续展开队员背景
hooks.excerpt: Search for supplies and face moral dilemmas in an event system where your choices matter Over 80 000 words of written content explore the lore of the Outbreak and the backstories of the various characters, and hidden surprises await even as you keep replaying the game
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
